lines.text: Dishonest scales are an abomination to the LORD, and when pride comes, disgrace follows.
Riches are worthless in the day of wrath, but righteousness brings deliverance from famine.
When the righteous thrive, the city rejoices, and by the blessing of the upright a city is built up.
A nation falls for lack of guidance, but with a large army comes deliverance.
A generous soul will prosper, and the people will curse the hoarder of grain.
